A calendar with all your work shifts.

Works with any number of shifts and every roster. Just enter the shift sequence and a start date.

The app generates a calendar showing the work shifts for each day in the year. You can edit single days to change shifts or mark them as holidays. 

Shift calendar marks public holidays and school vacations for more than 30 countries.
